instructions: Results are evidence only; never overwrite from the measurement-pack generator. Null means not measured. RECORDED/REVIEWED never clear CNC blockers. Every measurement needs its own value with units, physical source, raw repeat readings and evidence file. Component references join all feature groups to the complete measurement list; shared measurements require the same identified part and a per-feature datum transform review.
